doc: Gemma-4 Unified, the text decoder: Gemma-4's block (sandwich norms, per-head q/k norms with gains and a weightless v norm, sliding/global layers with their own rope keyed by layer type, the layer scalar, k=v on the global layers, KV sharing, the double-wide MLP) WITHOUT the per-layer input (PLE) tables and WITHOUT the MoE block (both attributes are removed from the unified text config). use_bidirectional_attention = vision only changes the mask of vision tokens: text-only prompts are plain causal. PENDING VALIDATION (written during the quiet window). Third-party adapter (lane H): data only, extends the built-in gemma4-text.
